validator.ledger_format: {"shots":[{"shot_id","step_id","playback","t_in","t_out"}, ...]} or a bare list; exit status 0 = all checks pass

verse.meter: classical alexandrine 6+6, pulse 0.30 s, caesura gap 0.45 s; onset(k) = on + (k-1)*0.30 + (k>6)*0.45; caesura midpoint = on + 2.025

lines.text: Voici les quatre anneaux | que la main a gardés.
elisions: quatr(e) + anneaux: mute e elided before a vowel (syllable 5 'tr'an')
lines.caesura: after 'anneaux' (syllable 6, masculine); no mute e at the break
lines.notes: 'Voici' = 2 syllables; 'que' (syll. 7) counts before the consonant l; 'main a' is a nasal vowel before a vowel, admitted in classical prosody (not a hiatus).
lines.gloss: Here are the four rings that the hand has kept.

lines.cue: C1 ON the caesura: cut at the gap midpoint 13.025 s
lines.text: Chaque anneau s'en revient | au bras qui l'a nourri.
lines.caesura: after 'revient' (syllable 6, masculine; 'vient' monosyllabic by usage); liaison t into 'au'
lines.notes: CHANGED from plan draft '... au bras qui l'a coulé': the runner arm does not cast the ring, it feeds it (French 'canal d'alimentation' = runner), so 'nourri' is the process-true verb. Same count, same caesura, same cue.
lines.gloss: Each ring comes back to the arm that fed it.

lines.cue: C2 AGAINST the caesura: cut on the onset of syllable 5 at 20.80 s, 0.825 s before the caesura midpoint 21.625
lines.text: Le rouge se retire, | et la forme est un creux.
elisions: retir(e) + et: the feminine e after syllable 6 ELIDES before the vowel of 'et' (regular caesura, not epic)
lines.caesura: after 'reti-' (syllable 6), its mute e absorbed by elision into 'et'
lines.notes: 'rou-ge' counts its mute e before the consonant s. CORRECTION to plan.md/test-shot labels: syllable 5 is 're' (first syllable of 'retire'), not '-ti-'; '-ti-' is syllable 6 at 21.10. The time of C2 (20.80) is unchanged: the cut lands as the word 'retire' begins.
lines.gloss: The red withdraws, and the form is a hollow.
caption_hemistichs: et la forme est un creux.

lines.cue: free; line ends 33.45; chord at 33.60; cut to the heap at 35.00 in a line gap
lines.text: L'objet était un arbre, | et l'arbre était du grain.
elisions: arbr(e) + et across the caesura (regular, not epic)
lines.notes: Liaisons: objet_était, était_un, un_arbre. No hiatus.
lines.gloss: The object was a tree, and the tree was grain.

cue_check.C1_frames: 13.025 s = frame 312.6; frames 312 (13.000) and 313 (13.042) are both within +-1 frame; the cutout unit lands ring 1 home on frame 312 and cuts between 312 and 313

changes_vs_plan: L3 cue syllable label corrected: syllable 5 = 're', not '-ti-' (time unchanged)

sound.format: WAV 44.1 kHz stereo 16-bit, each 38.000 s, aligned at film t=0, one fixed scale for all stems (sum at suggested gains)

stems.meter.wav: HANDMADE performed meter: 48 struck-plastic pulses (12 per line) with the 0.45 s caesura gap and accents on syllables 6 and 12 (louder, longer). L1 hollow ring clicks (modal synthesis, free-ring flexural ratios 1:2.83:5.43:8.87, f0 ~1180 Hz with a rising-then-falling pitch contour); L2 lower hollow runner-arm clicks (free-free beam ratios, f0 ~640 Hz); L3 viscous low tones (~98 Hz drooping, with a wet blub; final syllable 74 Hz); L4 granular bursts of 22-40 micro-grains. Measured onset error vs cue sheet: max 0.005 s over 48 pulses (< 1 frame); the gap before each 2nd hemistich is silent in this stem.
stems.ring_events.wav: HANDMADE: Sh1 ring set down at 0.60 with a 3-bounce rattle; Sh2 per ring a lift-off tick + 0.45 s air whoosh at launch (10.30, 11.10, 11.80, 12.50) and a snap home on the gate (13.000 = ring 1 on frame 312 just before C1; 14.000, 14.700, 15.300), rings 2-4 followed by a settle rattle derived from the cutout unit's spring-damper (3.2 Hz, zeta 0.22), all ended before 15.75; silence (room only) 15.9-17.6. Times read from geometry.json timing.
stems.drain.wav: HANDMADE: Sh3b drain tone 21.00-26.30, falling 190->55 Hz with gurgle; four cavity-release suctions FAR TO NEAR at 21.90, 22.90, 23.90, 24.90 (1.0 s apart, nearer ones louder) - PROPOSED times for the melt unit's larger drain-order spacing; sprue glug at 26.20.
stems.rain.wav: HANDMADE: granular pellet rain, sound-only transition 26.80-27.60 over the still empty mould (18 -> 160 grains/s), thickening through Sh4 to ~500/s at 33.60, ducked 0.12 s under each L4 pulse so the meter stays countable, thinning after the chord, then the last duller grains landing on the heap 35.0-36.5; 0.8 s ahead of the Sh4 picture.
stems.chord.wav: HANDMADE: struck chord at 33.60 on locked rational ratios 1:3/2:2:5/2:3:4 over 110 Hz (the Whitney alignment heard) with a plastic transient; decays mostly before 35.0.
stems.room.wav: HANDMADE room tone 0-38 s: low pink air + faint 50/100 Hz hum, fades out 36.6-37.8 to silence at 38.0.
stems.press_foraged.wav: FORAGED: the real Engel injection moulding machine recording (source 2.0-12.8 s), band-limited 30-2500 Hz and set about 18 dB down as a faint press bed under L3: fades in 18.8-19.8, out 26.4-27.4 so the pellet rain enters over near-silence.
stems.mix_preview.wav: sum of all stems at suggested gains (reference for the editor, not a master)

evidence.title: Injection moulding process (1).png
